data.narrative:
Bountiful is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Megan Nunes, Tomas Svitek, and Michael Bertino, having raised $5.0M to date. The comparable universe consists of one public company (277810.KQ) and eight private peers in robotics and manufacturing, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable and yields a $12M implied valuation, using a 2.5x multiplier applied to the $5M raised as a valuation proxy and reflecting typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up dynamics. Peer-median approach is not applicable due to insufficient comparable narrowing; while ten same-sector peers exist, fewer than three meet filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier positioning. An all-sector median would introduce excessive heterogeneity and is therefore excluded.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $11M to $14M (median $12M), anchored to a single methodological leg. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer trading multiples and the reliance on stage-progression as the sole quantitative anchor. The tight comp set and early stage heighten sensitivity to assumptions around revenue trajectory, market timing, and subsequent fundraising terms. Additional data on comparable seed-stage robotics financing rounds or preliminary revenue metrics would materially narrow this band.
